_comment: The frontend checkouts frontend-change works in, one profile per set.
frontend-change reads repo (the workspace-relative checkout), scope (the
set's folder inside it) and verify.* (npm script names run there, one per
rung of the verification ladder: unit, format, lint, e2e). Omit a verify
repos maps frontend, backend and tests onto a workspace-relative path and a
GitHub owner/name slug each; repo must be one of those paths. sources[]
records the requirement sources each set was distilled from.
